name: Room 1: Lena's Bedroom

sub_sections.name: Victorian Master Bedroom
sub_sections.connection: Secret passage behind wardrobe opens to 1C_closet

sub_sections.name: Hidden Ritual Alcove
sub_sections.connection: Exit key unlocks door in 1A leading to Room 2

horror_progression: Step 1: Enter 1A - Wind rattles the front door shut, latch locks automatically.
Step 2: Enter 1B - Player sees figure outside window; inspecting wardrobe causes closet doors to creak open.
Step 3: In 1C - Collect ritual fragment; audio footsteps echo in 1B bedroom behind player.
Step 4: Returning to 1A - Mirror in hallway reflects figure raising hand; door to Room 2 unlocks.

name: Room 2: Daniel's Study

sub_sections.name: Investigation Office
sub_sections.connection: Moving fake book swings open bookshelf into 2B_darkroom

sub_sections.name: Red-Light Audio/Photo Lab
sub_sections.connection: Unlocks heavy iron trapdoor leading down into Basement (Room 3)

horror_progression: Step 1: In 2A - Terminal hums; entering failed code triggers siren blare and cuts lights to emergency green.
Step 2: Solving bookcase mechanism reveals 2B bathed in blood-red chemical light.
Step 3: Playing tape in 2B broadcasts distorted breathing that follows player into 2A.
Step 4: Basement trapdoor bolts slam open with heavy metallic clang.

name: Room 3: The Basement Bunker

sub_sections.name: Boiler & Electrical Hub
sub_sections.connection: Equalizing valve pressure unlocks rusted security gate into 3B_cells

sub_sections.name: Flooded Detention Cages
sub_sections.connection: Round 1 Complete! Heavy blast hatch opens to Round 2

horror_progression: Step 1: In 3A - Steam hisses from broken pipes; player must turn 3 valves in correct sequence.
Step 2: Security gate raises into 3B; water is knee-deep, splashing with every step.
Step 3: While entering final code on 3B console, unseen entity splashes through water behind player.
Step 4: Blast hatch unlocks; emergency amber sirens guide player into Round 2.

name: Room 4: The Rotting Archive

sub_sections.name: Decontamination Fork Chamber
sub_sections.connection: Correct wing choice unlocks transition to Room 5

horror_progression: Step 1: In 4A - JS-01: Filing cabinet drawer violently ejects when passing within 1.5m.
Step 2: In 4B - Inspecting Polaroid on microfilm viewer triggers JS-02: photograph head turns.
Step 3: In 4B - Water ripples form from dark corner of 4A; follower footstep echoes start.
Step 4: In 4C - Rotary fork selection locks in; bulkhead door unseals with decompression blast.

name: Room 5: The Surveillance Morgue

sub_sections.name: Observation Command Deck
sub_sections.connection: Reinforced observation window overlooks 5B; keycard door unlocks 5B

sub_sections.name: Autopsy & Cold Storage Hall
sub_sections.connection: Keycard found inside morgue locker unlocks airlock 5C

sub_sections.name: High-Security Containment Airlock
sub_sections.connection: Leads directly to Room 6 (The Anointing Vault)

horror_progression: Step 1: In 5A - Intercom crackles to life; mid-sentence voice cuts out. Monitor 4 displays empty gurney in 5B.
Step 2: Enter 5B - Plastic sheeting billows with no air currents; opening cold storage reveals Corvin's active badge.
Step 3: Looking back through window from 5B to 5A: monitor screens display the team's live name as active subjects.
Step 4: JS-03: The corner entity slowly crawls out from beneath plastic quarantine tarp; airlock 5C unlocks!

name: Room 6: The Anointing Vault

sub_sections.name: Power Failsafe Conduit
sub_sections.connection: Restoring circuit power opens massive vault doors to 6B_tomb

sub_sections.name: The Core Containment Chamber
sub_sections.connection: Final Containment Sealed! Game Complete & Victory Achieved!

horror_progression: Step 1: In 6A - Siren wails; 4-digit spectrogram code is entered into logic gate switchboard.
Step 2: In 6B - Corvin's badge inserted into master console; countdown timer initiates on massive wall display.
Step 3: Suspended cage violently thrashes on iron chains; flesh organism pulses red light in time with alarm.
Step 4: All 3 containment levers pulled simultaneously; steam hisses and final containment locks down!
